sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，人们在加利福尼亚州的一座葡萄园里发现了一具女性尸体。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她遭到斩首，体内的血也被放干了。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机来掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，人们只知道她叫无名氏。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 随后，侦探们终于得知了她的名字——阿达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但是，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now, wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《阿达》是 Casefile Presents 推出的全新系列节目，各大播客平台现已上线。

sentences.en: On Tuesday the 2nd of November 1999, Donna Wheeler was murdered in her home at Borella, in Western Sydney.
sentences.zh: 1999年11月2日，星期二，唐娜·惠勒在悉尼西部博雷拉的家中遇害。

sentences.en: But who was responsible?
sentences.zh: 但究竟是谁干的？

sentences.en: Was it her ex-husband John who found a body and alerted the police?
sentences.zh: 是发现尸体并报警的前夫约翰吗？

sentences.en: Was it her violent ex-boyfriend Keith who was recently charged for assaulting Donna?
sentences.zh: 是最近因殴打唐娜而被起诉的暴力前男友基思吗？

sentences.en: Keith wouldn't have been happy that Donna was spending a lot of time with his brother Colin since they separated.
sentences.zh: 自从两人分手后，唐娜一直花很多时间跟他的弟弟科林在一起，基思对此肯定很不高兴。

sentences.en: Speaking of Colin, he was seen with Donna on the night of her murder.
sentences.zh: 说到科林，有人看到他在谋杀当晚和唐娜在一起。

sentences.en: And then there was the phone call she received from a male caller asking to meet him that night.
sentences.zh: 还有她接到的一通男性来电，对方要求当晚与她见面。

sentences.en: Donna Wheeler was 30 years old at the time of her death in 1999.
sentences.zh: 1999年唐娜·惠勒遇害时年仅30岁。

sentences.en: She lived at Kingsland Road in Borella, which is west of the Sydney City area.
sentences.zh: 她住在博雷拉的金斯兰路，位于悉尼市区以西。

sentences.en: She was a bright and sparkly person who was well-liked by everybody.
sentences.zh: 她是一个阳光开朗、人见人爱的人。

sentences.en: She had a lot of friends and they described her as a beautiful, caring and loving person.
sentences.zh: 她有很多朋友，他们形容她是一个美丽、有爱心且充满关怀的人。

sentences.en: She had one son from a previous marriage who was aged 12 at the time.
sentences.zh: 她与前夫育有一子，当时12岁。

sentences.en: She was an excellent mother, very loving and supportive of her son.
sentences.zh: 她是一位出色的母亲，对儿子充满关爱与支持。

sentences.en: The first Tuesday of November is the day that a horse race stops Australia, Melbourne Cup Day, the day that everybody becomes a horse racing expert.
sentences.zh: 十一月的第一个星期二是一场让澳大利亚为之停摆的赛马日——墨尔本杯日，这一天每个人都成了赛马专家。

sentences.en: It's the biggest race of the year.
sentences.zh: 这是一年中规模最大的赛事。

sentences.en: The night before the Cup, Donna had been having a few drinks with Colin Bond at the Regent's Park Hotel, one of the local watering holes.
sentences.zh: 就在杯赛前夕，唐娜和科林·邦德在当地的一家酒吧摄政公园酒店喝了几杯。

sentences.en: Donna had become friends with Colin through her ex-boyfriend Keith Bond.
sentences.zh: 唐娜是通过前男友基思·邦德认识科林并成为朋友的。

sentences.en: Keith and Colin were brothers who lived together at Amy Street in Regent's Park.
sentences.zh: 基思和科林是兄弟，住在摄政公园的艾米街。

sentences.en: Only a few minutes drive from Donna's house at Borella.
sentences.zh: 距离唐娜在博雷拉的家只有几分钟的车程。

sentences.en: Donna had only split up with Keith a few weeks before.
sentences.zh: 唐娜和基思分手才区区几周。

sentences.en: It was described as a volatile, violent relationship.
sentences.zh: 这段关系被形容为充满动荡和暴力。

sentences.en: At times they would get on and everything would be fine, but Keith wanted more than Donna was willing to give him.
sentences.zh: 有时他们相处融洽，一切都好，但基思想要的远超唐娜愿意付出的。

sentences.en: And this upset Keith.
sentences.zh: 这让基思很不高兴。

sentences.en: Keith wanted a serious relationship with Donna.
sentences.zh: 基思想要和唐娜建立一段认真的关系。

sentences.en: He constantly professed his love for her and said he wanted to get married and have kids.
sentences.zh: 他不断向她表白，说想结婚生子。

sentences.en: She really wasn't looking to settle down into another serious relationship.
sentences.zh: 她其实并不想安定下来去开展另一段认真的感情。

sentences.en: She wasn't looking for a partner.
sentences.zh: 她并不在乎找个伴侣。

sentences.en: She'd been there and done that.
sentences.zh: 她经历过那些，也看透了。

sentences.en: She just wanted to be friends.
sentences.zh: 她只想做朋友。

sentences.en: Keith couldn't accept that and it was the cause of a lot of fights between them.
sentences.zh: 基思无法接受这一点，这也是他们频频争吵的导火索。

sentences.en: It was when one of these fights turned physical that the relationship ended.
sentences.zh: 正是在其中一次争吵升级为肢体冲突时，这段感情走到了尽头。

sentences.en: Keith struck Donna hard, causing her front tooth to break.
sentences.zh: 基思狠狠地打了唐娜，导致她的门牙被打断。

sentences.en: The police were called and Keith was arrested and charged for assault.
sentences.zh: 警方随后赶到，基思因涉嫌袭击被捕并被起诉。

sentences.en: An apprehended violence order, what some would know as a restraining order, was taken out to keep Keith away from Donna.
sentences.zh: 法院向基思下达了限制令（即俗称的防止暴力令），以防他靠近唐娜。

sentences.en: But a piece of paper wasn't going to stop Keith.
sentences.zh: 但一张纸是阻止不了基思的。

sentences.en: He was obsessed.
sentences.zh: 他已经走火入魔了。

sentences.en: Not long after that, Donna woke up to find the tyres on her car had been slashed.
sentences.zh: 没过多久，唐娜醒来发现自己汽车的轮胎被划破了。

sentences.en: Keith was the prime suspect, but of course nobody saw anything so it couldn't be proven.
sentences.zh: 基思是头号嫌疑人，但当然没人看到任何证据，所以无法证实。

sentences.en: Since Donna had split with Keith, she'd become a lot closer to his brother, Colin, and they spent a lot of time together.
sentences.zh: 自从唐娜和基思分手后，她和他的弟弟科林走得更近了，两人花了很多时间在一起。

sentences.en: Keith wasn't overly impressed with this.
sentences.zh: 基思对此并不是特别高兴。

sentences.en: So it was that night, the 1st of November 1999, the eve of Melbourne Cup Day, that Donna gave Colin $20 to put a bet on for her on the big race.
sentences.zh: 正因如此，在1999年11月1日那个墨尔本杯日的前夕，唐娜给了科林20澳元，让他帮自己在超级大赛中下注。

sentences.en: She wanted $10 each way on the Bart Cummings trained horse, Rogan Josh.
sentences.zh: 她想在巴特·卡明斯训练的赛马“罗甘乔什”身上各押10澳元的正反盘。

sentences.en: And what happened that next day?
sentences.zh: 第二天发生了什么？

sentences.en: With Zaza Bell on the outside and Rogan Josh, travel mates trying to get into the clear and so is the hind, it's tight there.
sentences.zh: 扎扎·贝尔在外侧，罗甘乔什与同伴试图寻找突围空间，后面那匹也是，竞争非常白热化。

sentences.en: Rogan Josh with Central Park and the Warrior, the three leaders from Zaza Bell on the outside.
sentences.zh: 罗甘乔什与中央公园和勇士，领跑的三匹马在外侧紧咬扎扎·贝尔。

sentences.en: It's Central Park, the Warrior and Rogan Josh.
sentences.zh: 是中央公园、勇士和罗甘乔什。

sentences.en: Rogan Josh and Central Park.
sentences.zh: 罗甘乔什与中央公园。

sentences.en: Rogan Josh, but did it again.
sentences.zh: 罗甘乔什，再次做到了。

sentences.en: Rogan Josh from Central Park.
sentences.zh: 罗甘乔什力压中央公园。

sentences.en: Photo third over Lahara, Zaza Bell from Travel Mate and the Warrior.
sentences.zh: 照片判定第三名是拉哈拉，扎扎·贝尔领先于旅行伙伴和勇士。

sentences.en: Donna had done it.
sentences.zh: 唐娜做到了。

sentences.en: She picked the winner.
sentences.zh: 她押中了赢家。

sentences.en: She couldn't enjoy it straight away though, she was at work.
sentences.zh: 不过她无法立刻享受这份喜悦，因为她还在上班。

sentences.en: But once she finished her shift, she made her way to the Regent's Park Hotel.
sentences.zh: 但一交班，她就赶往了摄政公园酒店。

sentences.en: She got there just after 6pm where she met Colin, who had been there drinking most of the day.
sentences.zh: 她在傍晚6点刚过抵达那里，见到了已经在那里喝了一整天酒的科林。

sentences.en: Colin handed over Donna's winnings and then they shared a few drinks together in celebration.
sentences.zh: 科林把唐娜的奖金交给了她，两人随后喝了几杯以示庆祝。

sentences.en: A little while later, they decided to change location and go to the Regent's Park Bowling Club.
sentences.zh: 过了一会儿，他们决定换个地方，前往摄政公园保龄球俱乐部。

sentences.en: This might have had something to do with the fact that Keith had just turned up to the Regent's Park Hotel.
sentences.zh: 这可能与基思刚刚出现在摄政公园酒店的事实有关。

sentences.en: They played the poker machines and had a few more drinks at the bowling club.
sentences.zh: 他们在保龄球俱乐部玩了老虎机，又喝了几杯。

sentences.en: Not long after that, Donna is said to call from her ex-husband, John.
sentences.zh: 没过多久，据说唐娜接到了前夫约翰的电话。

sentences.en: John had their 12-year-old son at the time.
sentences.zh: 约翰当时带着他们12岁的儿子。

sentences.en: John tells Donna that he needs to borrow some money and Donna agrees.
sentences.zh: 约翰告诉唐娜他需要借点钱，唐娜答应了。

sentences.en: So they arrange to meet in the nearby suburb of Strathfield.
sentences.zh: 于是他们约定在附近的斯特拉斯菲尔德郊区见面。

sentences.en: Donna tells Colin what's going on and he asks Donna to drop him back at the Regent's Park Hotel.
sentences.zh: 唐娜把情况告诉了科林，科林让她顺路把他送回摄政公园酒店。

sentences.en: He said he'll order some takeaway Chinese food from the bistro for them while she goes and meets John.
sentences.zh: 他说在她去见约翰期间，他会在小酒馆帮两人点一些中式外卖。

sentences.en: Donna agreed to that.
sentences.zh: 唐娜同意了。

sentences.en: So they go back to the Regent's Park Hotel and then Donna goes off to meet her ex-husband, John.
sentences.zh: 于是他们返回摄政公园酒店，随后唐娜动身去见前夫约翰。

sentences.en: After her meeting with John, where she arranged to pick their son up the next evening,
sentences.zh: 在与约翰见面并商定好第二天傍晚接儿子之后，

sentences.en: Donna returns to the Regent's Park Hotel.
sentences.zh: 唐娜回到了摄政公园酒店。

sentences.en: Colin is waiting at the bar with the Chinese food.
sentences.zh: 科林正拿着中式外卖在吧台等候。

sentences.en: They leave together and go back to Donna's house to eat.
sentences.zh: 他们一起离开，回到唐娜的家用餐。

sentences.en: It's here while they're eating that Colin says Donna got another phone call from an unknown caller.
sentences.zh: 正是在这里用餐时，科林说唐娜接到了另一个未知来电。

sentences.en: After the call, Donna told Colin she had to leave and go and see somebody in Strathfield again.
sentences.zh: 通话结束后，唐娜告诉科林她得离开，再去斯特拉斯菲尔德见一个人。

sentences.en: And she had to leave straight away, no time to finish dinner.
sentences.zh: 而且她必须马上走，连吃晚饭的时间都没有。

sentences.en: Colin says that's fine but asks if Donna can drop him home on her way.
sentences.zh: 科林说没问题，但问唐娜能不能顺路把他送回家。

sentences.en: Donna agrees and Colin says he gets home somewhere around 9 or 9.30pm.
sentences.zh: 唐娜答应了，科林说他大约在晚上9点或9点30分左右到家。

sentences.en: Colin is the last known person to see Donna alive.
sentences.zh: 科林是目前已知的最后一个见到活着的唐娜的人。

sentences.en: The next day, Wednesday the 3rd of November 1999,
sentences.zh: 第二天，1999年11月3日，星期三，

sentences.en: John makes a few attempts to call Donna but he can't get a hold of her.
sentences.zh: 约翰给唐娜打了好几个电话，但都联系不上她。

sentences.en: Nothing too unusual, she's at work so he doesn't think too much of it.
sentences.zh: 这并不算太寻常，她在上班，所以他没多想。

sentences.en: But as the morning turned to afternoon and the afternoon turned to evening,
sentences.zh: 但随着清晨转为下午，下午又转为傍晚，

sentences.en: John started to worry.
sentences.zh: 约翰开始担心起来。

sentences.en: By evening he still hadn't heard from Donna and that was unusual.
sentences.zh: 到了傍晚，他依然没有唐娜的音讯，这很不寻常。

sentences.en: Donna should have answered or at least returned his phone calls by now.
sentences.zh: 唐娜现在理应接听电话，或者至少该回电了。

sentences.en: It was out of character for her.
sentences.zh: 这不符合她的性格。

sentences.en: If she didn't answer, she would always ring back.
sentences.zh: 如果她没接，总是会回电话的。

sentences.en: He had their son and he needed to make sure she was still right to picking him up at the time they had arranged the night before.
sentences.zh: 他带着他们的儿子，他必须确认她是否还能按照昨晚商定的时间接走孩子。

sentences.en: She would always ring the day they were exchanged in custody to make sure everything was still right to go ahead.
sentences.zh: 每次到抚养权交接的日子，她总是会打电话来确认一切是否按计划进行。

sentences.en: John starts to call friends and family.
sentences.zh: 约翰开始给亲朋好友打电话。

sentences.en: He calls Donna's mother.
sentences.zh: 他打给唐娜的母亲。

sentences.en: She says that she hasn't heard from Donna either.
sentences.zh: 她表示也没有唐娜的消息。

sentences.en: John tries other friends and family without any luck.
sentences.zh: 约翰又联系了其他亲友，但毫无结果。

sentences.en: He rings Donna's mother back and she suggests that John go to Donna's house.
sentences.zh: 他回电话给唐娜的母亲，对方建议约翰去唐娜家看看。

sentences.en: She said, you'll know if she is home straight away because her car will be parked out the front.
sentences.zh: 她说，你一到门前看到车停在那儿，就知道她在家了。

sentences.en: John drives to Donna's house and their son was still with him.
sentences.zh: 约翰开车去唐娜家，他们的儿子当时仍跟他在一起。

sentences.en: They find Donna's red Mitsubishi lanser parked out the front under the carport.
sentences.zh: 他们发现唐娜红色的三菱蓝瑟轿车停在门前的车棚下。

sentences.en: Their son has a key for Donna's place and so John grabs the key and goes inside.
sentences.zh: 他们的儿子有唐娜家的钥匙，于是约翰拿过钥匙走了进去。

sentences.en: As you walk inside the house, there is a bedroom off to the right and the entrance to the lounge room is off to the left.
sentences.zh: 一进屋，右手边是一个卧室，左手边是通往客厅的入口。

sentences.en: It was here at the entrance to the lounge room that John finds Donna's body.
sentences.zh: 正是在客厅入口处，约翰发现了唐娜的尸体。

sentences.en: He immediately makes a frantic phone call to Donna's mum and to the police.
sentences.zh: 他立即慌乱地给唐娜的母亲和警方打了电话。

sentences.en: Police arrive soon after.
sentences.zh: 警察很快赶到。

sentences.en: The house was immediately taped off and a crime scene was established.
sentences.zh: 房子随即被拉起警戒线，并设立了犯罪现场。

sentences.en: Donna was covered in blood.
sentences.zh: 唐娜浑身是血。

sentences.en: She had multiple stab wounds and her face was badly bruised and swollen.
sentences.zh: 她有多处刀伤，脸部严重淤青红肿。

sentences.en: She was naked from the waist down.
sentences.zh: 她腰部以下赤裸。

sentences.en: The lounge room was in complete disarray and it was clear a violent struggle had occurred.
sentences.zh: 客厅一片狼藉，显然发生过激烈的搏斗。

sentences.en: There were things all over the place.
sentences.zh: 到处都是杂物。

sentences.en: There was a pillow and a plastic bag located next to her head.
sentences.zh: 她的头部旁边放着一个枕头和一个塑料袋。

sentences.en: Both had blood on them.
sentences.zh: 两者上面都有血迹。

sentences.en: There was a towel located in the lounge room with blood all over it.
sentences.zh: 客厅里有一条沾满血迹的毛巾。

sentences.en: A knife was found in the corner of the lounge room with blood on it and the blade had been bent.
sentences.zh: 客厅角落里发现了一把沾有血迹的刀，刀刃已经弯曲。

sentences.en: Such was the ferocious nature of the attack.
sentences.zh: 可见袭击手段是何等残忍凶狠。

sentences.en: On the coffee table, there were three containers of Chinese food, all partly eaten.
sentences.zh: 咖啡桌上放着三盒中式外卖，都只吃了一部分。

sentences.en: Next to the Chinese containers were two bowls and a bottle of Tui's beer.
sentences.zh: 中式快餐盒旁有两个碗和一瓶图伊啤酒。

sentences.en: On the floor were two spoons, two forks and another bottle of Tui's beer and a can of vodka.
sentences.zh: 地板上放着两把勺子、两把叉子、另一瓶图伊啤酒以及一罐伏特加。

sentences.en: There was no sign of forced entry to the house.
sentences.zh: 屋里没有强行闯入的痕迹。

sentences.en: Police think her attack was very quick, over in a matter of minutes.
sentences.zh: 警方认为袭击非常迅速，在几分钟内就结束了。

sentences.en: An impulse attack.
sentences.zh: 这是一场冲动行事的袭击。

sentences.en: Donna may not have even had a chance to scream.
sentences.zh: 唐娜甚至可能连尖叫的机会都没有。

sentences.en: So the fact that the neighbours said they heard nothing wasn't a great surprise, as police were of the belief there may not have been anything to hear.
sentences.zh: 因此，邻居们说没听到任何动静并不令人意外，因为警方认为可能根本没有什么动静可听。

sentences.en: John was taken back to the police station with his and Donna's son, where they were both interviewed.
sentences.zh: 约翰和他和唐娜的儿子被带回警察局并分别接受了讯问。

sentences.en: John immediately tells them about Keith, Donna's violent ex-partner.
sentences.zh: 约翰立刻向他们提及了基思——唐娜那个有暴力倾向的前男友。

sentences.en: John was well aware of the volatile nature of their relationship.
sentences.zh: 约翰对他们关系的动荡本质心知肚明。

sentences.en: Police interviewed John extensively and traced his movements the previous night, and his story checked out.
sentences.zh: 警方对约翰进行了深入讯问，并追查了他前一晚的行踪，他的说辞得到了证实。

sentences.en: They were able to conclusively say he had nothing to do with her murder.
sentences.zh: 他们能够确凿地证明他与这起谋杀案无关。

sentences.en: Ruling John out put one person straight to the top of the suspect liSt.
sentences.zh: 排除约翰的嫌疑后，有一个人直接跃居嫌疑人名单的首位。

sentences.en: Keith Bond.
sentences.zh: 基思·邦德。

sentences.en: Police pull up Keith's record and see that there was the recent assault charge against Donna and the apprehended violence order application.
sentences.zh: 警方调阅了基思的案底，发现近期有针对唐娜的袭击指控以及防止暴力令的申请记录。

sentences.en: They see the history of violence throughout the relationship.
sentences.zh: 他们看到了整段感情中充满暴力的过往。

sentences.en: He immediately becomes the focal point of the police investigation.
sentences.zh: 他立刻成为了警方调查的核心焦点。

sentences.en: Detectives visited Keith's house on Amy Street, Regent's Park, at 7.30am the next morning,
sentences.zh: 第二天清晨7点30分，侦探们造访了位于摄政公园艾米街的基思家，

sentences.en: Thursday the 4th of November, 1999.
sentences.zh: 即1999年11月4日，星期四。

sentences.en: No one was home at this time.
sentences.zh: 当时家里没人。

sentences.en: They knocked on a few neighbours' doors and found that along with his brother Colin, a third man Peter, also lived with them.
sentences.zh: 他们敲了几位邻居的门，得知除了他的弟弟科林外，还有第三名男子彼得也和他们住在一起。

sentences.en: They decided to try again a bit later and left.
sentences.zh: 他们决定过会儿再来，于是便离开了。

sentences.en: When they returned a few hours later, they were out of luck again with Keith, but Colin Bond answered the door.
sentences.zh: 几个小时后他们折返，结果依然没碰见基思，但科林·邦德开了门。

sentences.en: Colin was cooperative and invited the detectives inside.
sentences.zh: 科林很配合，并邀请侦探们进屋。

sentences.en: He told them that Keith was at work for the day and their other flatmate Peter wasn't home either.
sentences.zh: 他告诉他们基思白天去上班了，另一个室友彼得也不在家。

sentences.en: Detectives got talking with Colin and asked if he knew Donna.
sentences.zh: 侦探们和科林聊了起来，问他是否认识唐娜。

sentences.en: He said of course, Donna was Keith's ex-girlfriend.
sentences.zh: 他说当然认识，唐娜是基思的前女友。

sentences.en: Colin told police that Keith and Donna used to fight constantly.
sentences.zh: 科林告诉警方，基思和唐娜过去经常吵架。

sentences.en: He felt bad for Donna because of the way Keith treated her.
sentences.zh: 他为唐娜感到难过，因为基思对她不好。

sentences.en: One night got so bad that Colin stepped in and had a punch-up with Keith over how he was treating Donna.
sentences.zh: 有一次情况恶劣到科林不得不介入，并为了基思如何对待唐娜的事跟他打了一架。

sentences.en: Detectives asked him when the last time he saw Donna was and he told them about being with her Tuesday night at the Regent's Park Hotel.
sentences.zh: 侦探们询问科林上一次见到唐娜是什么时候，他告诉他们他周二晚上在摄政公园酒店和她在一起。

sentences.en: Then they left and had some takeaway Chinese food at her place before Donna got a phone call and had to leave.
sentences.zh: 然后他们离开，在她家吃了点中式外卖，之后唐娜接到一个电话，不得不离开。

sentences.en: Well, what an answer that was.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这可真是个回答。

sentences.en: Colin certainly got the attention of detectives with that one.
sentences.zh: 科林这一回答确实引起了侦探们的注意。

sentences.en: Colin agrees to go with detectives back to the station to conduct a recorded interview.
sentences.zh: 科林同意和侦探们一起回局里接受录音讯问。

sentences.en: He wasn't under arreSt.
sentences.zh: 他当时并没有被捕。

sentences.en: He went voluntarily.
sentences.zh: 他是自愿去的。

sentences.en: He was very cooperative and wanted to help the investigation.
sentences.zh: 他非常配合，并希望协助调查。

sentences.en: He liked Donna.
sentences.zh: 他喜欢唐娜。

sentences.en: He wanted to help any way he could.
sentences.zh: 他想尽其所能提供帮助。

sentences.en: In that interview, Colin went back through his evening with Donna.
sentences.zh: 在那次讯问中，科林重新回顾了与唐娜度过的那个夜晚。

sentences.en: He added in that he had two bottles of Tui's beer and Donna had a can of vodka and these had been found at the scene by police.
sentences.zh: 他补充说，他喝了两瓶图伊啤酒，唐娜喝了一罐伏特加，这些都是警方在现场找到的。

sentences.en: He told detectives about the phone call that Donna had gotten while they were eating Chinese food and she said that she had to leave and go and meet somebody in Ashfield.
sentences.zh: 他告诉侦探们，唐娜在吃中餐时接到了一个电话，她说她必须离开，去阿什菲尔德见某个人。

sentences.en: He says her phone call was somewhere around 8.30 or 9 o'clock p.m.
sentences.zh: 他说那个电话大约是在晚上8点半或9点打来的。

sentences.en: He requested Donna drop him home, which she did.
sentences.zh: 他要求唐娜顺路送他回家，她照做了。

sentences.en: He told them he got home somewhere around 9 or 9.30 p.m.
sentences.zh: 他告诉他们，他大约在晚上9点或9点半到家。

sentences.en: He didn't see or hear from Donna again.
sentences.zh: 他再也没有见过唐娜，也没有她的消息。

sentences.en: During this interview, something else caught the eye of police.
sentences.zh: 在这次讯问中，还有一件事引起了警察的注意。

sentences.en: Colin's right hand was very swollen and there was also a cut on a knuckle.
sentences.zh: 科林的右手肿得厉害，指关节上还有一个伤口。

sentences.en: But that was easily explained.
sentences.zh: 但这很容易解释。

sentences.en: When asked about his hand, Colin had this to say.
sentences.zh: 当被问及他的手时，科林是这样说的。

sentences.en: Colin was the last known person to see Donna alive, so they were very interested in what he had to say, especially when he admitted going back to her place to eat Chinese food,
sentences.zh: 科林是最后一个知道还活着唐娜的人，所以他们对他说的话非常感兴趣，特别是当他承认回到她家吃中餐时，

sentences.en: which police had found half-eaten at the scene.
sentences.zh: 警察在现场发现了只吃了一半的中餐。

sentences.en: But he was being very cooperative.
sentences.zh: 但他非常配合。

sentences.en: He was happy to talk to detectives and to help out.
sentences.zh: 他很乐意与侦探交谈并提供帮助。

sentences.en: Surely he wouldn't be this helpful if he was guilty.
sentences.zh: 如果他是凶手，他肯定不会这么乐于助人。

sentences.en: And by now, police had confirmed that Donna did in fact receive two telephone calls around the time Colin had mentioned.
sentences.zh: 而此时，警方已经证实，唐娜在科林提到的那个时间段确实接到了两个电话。

sentences.en: One at 8.30 p.m., the other at 8.39 p.m.
sentences.zh: 一个在晚上8点30分，另一个在晚上8点39分。

sentences.en: Colin was telling the truth about that, so there was no reason to believe he was lying about anything else.
sentences.zh: 科林在这件事上说的是实话，所以没有理由相信他在其他事情上撒谎。

sentences.en: So who did Donna go and meet?
sentences.zh: 那么唐娜去见了谁呢？

sentences.en: And there was another problem that police had.
sentences.zh: 警察还面临另一个问题。

sentences.en: They still couldn't find Keith.
sentences.zh: 他们仍然找不到基思。

sentences.en: On that day, Thursday the 4th of November, police conducted a search warrant at Keith and Colin's place.
sentences.zh: 那一天，11月4日星期四，警方对基思和科林的住处执行了搜查令。

sentences.en: Not long into the search, they noticed a few smears of blood on the floor in the lounge room.
sentences.zh: 搜查没多久，他们就注意到起居室的地板上有几处血迹。

sentences.en: But it was easily explained.
sentences.zh: 但这很容易解释。

sentences.en: Both Colin and Keith had recently cut their fingers, so the blood could have been either of theirs.
sentences.zh: 科林和基思最近都割破了手指，所以血迹可能是他们俩任何一人的。

sentences.en: A sample was taken to match just in case.
sentences.zh: 为了以防万一，警方取样进行了比对。

sentences.en: The search was extensive and took around four hours.
sentences.zh: 搜查范围很广，大约花了四个小时。

sentences.en: Colin was present at the time of the search and a police officer noticed what looked like a blood smear on his watch.
sentences.zh: 搜查时科林在场，一名警官注意到他的手表上似乎有血迹。

sentences.en: Colin was questioned about it and he says it was probably blood from when he heard his hand gardening.
sentences.zh: 科林受到了盘问，他说这可能是他园艺时弄伤手时的血迹。

sentences.en: Police seized the watch for DNA testing.
sentences.zh: 警方没收了这块手表用于DNA检测。

sentences.en: They also took a ring he was wearing on his right hand.
sentences.zh: 他们还拿走了他戴在右手上的戒指。

sentences.en: Colin was still pretty nonplussed, didn't seem too phased.
sentences.zh: 科林依然相当淡定，似乎并没有太慌乱。

sentences.en: He handed the items over with no complaints.
sentences.zh: 他毫无怨言地交出了这些物品。

sentences.en: He was happy to help.
sentences.zh: 他很乐意帮忙。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, the DNA tests don't work as quick as the TV shows, so police wouldn't have any results back for a few weeks.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，DNA检测不像电视剧里那么快，所以警方几周内都不会有结果。

sentences.en: There was a bit to test too.
sentences.zh: 要检测的东西也挺多的。

sentences.en: They had all the blood-stained items found at the scene, the towel, the plastic bag, the knife, and now these few items from Colin, as well as the blood smear on the floor.
sentences.zh: 他们有在现场发现的所有带血物品、毛巾、塑料袋、刀，现在还有科林的这几件物品，以及地上的血迹。

sentences.en: But detectives couldn't just sit back and wait for the results.
sentences.zh: 但侦探们不能只是坐着等结果。

sentences.en: They had to keep working at it to see if they could solve it before then.
sentences.zh: 他们必须继续努力，看能否在此之前破案。

sentences.en: There was one other thing of interest found during the search warrant.
sentences.zh: 在执行搜查令时，还发现了另一件感兴趣的东西。

sentences.en: Underneath Keith's bed, there was a wallet.
sentences.zh: 在基思的床底下，有一个钱包。

sentences.en: Why was that wallet of interest?
sentences.zh: 为什么这个钱包会引起兴趣？

sentences.en: Because it was Donna's wallet.
sentences.zh: 因为那是唐娜的钱包。

sentences.en: Later that day, police found Keith.
sentences.zh: 那天晚些时候，警方找到了基思。

sentences.en: Or he found them.
sentences.zh: 或者说他找到了他们。

sentences.en: He heard police were trying to catch up with him, so he presented to the police station himself.
sentences.zh: 他听说警察在找他，于是自己去了警察局。

sentences.en: He also agreed to be interviewed.
sentences.zh: 他也同意接受讯问。

sentences.en: In relation to Donna's wallet being found under his bed,
sentences.zh: 关于在床底下发现唐娜的钱包一事，

sentences.en: Keith said Donna had left it there one night, and they broke up not long after that, so he kept it out of spite.
sentences.zh: 基思说唐娜有一天晚上把它落在那儿了，不久之后他们就分手了，所以他出于怨恨把它留下了。

sentences.en: He also immediately presented an alibi.
sentences.zh: 他还立刻拿出了不在场证明。

sentences.en: He said shortly after breaking up with Donna, he started seeing a new girl, Debbie, and he was with her on the night of Donna's death.
sentences.zh: 他说，和唐娜分手后不久，他开始和一个新女孩黛比交往，在唐娜遇害当晚他和她在一起。

sentences.en: Keith was up front with detectives about why he'd broken up with Donna.
sentences.zh: 关于为什么和唐娜分手，基思向侦探们坦诚相告。

sentences.en: He told them about the assault charge.
sentences.zh: 他向他们讲述了袭警指控的事。

sentences.en: But that's no great surprise.
sentences.zh: 但这并不让人感到太意外。

sentences.en: He would have already known that they knew about that.
sentences.zh: 他本就该知道他们已经了解了这件事。

sentences.en: Keith gave the following version of events.
sentences.zh: 基思给出了以下版本的经过。

sentences.en: On Melbourne Cup Day, Tuesday the 2nd of November 1999,
sentences.zh: 在墨尔本杯赛马日，1999年11月2日星期二，

sentences.en: Keith was with his new girlfriend Debbie at the Regent's Park Bowling Club.
sentences.zh: 基思和他的新女友黛比在摄政公园保龄球俱乐部。

sentences.en: About 7pm, Keith left Debbie at the bowling club to play bingo, and he decided to go to the Regent's Park Hotel.
sentences.zh: 大约晚上7点，基思离开保龄球俱乐部的黛比去玩宾果游戏，他决定去摄政公园酒店。

sentences.en: When he got to the hotel, he saw Donna and Colin.
sentences.zh: 当他到达酒店时，他看到了唐娜和科林。

sentences.en: He noticed that Donna and Colin left soon after.
sentences.zh: 他注意到唐娜和科林不久后就离开了。

sentences.en: Colin returned by himself a bit later on, and then Donna returned after that.
sentences.zh: 过了一会儿，科林独自一人回来了，接着唐娜也回来了。

sentences.en: He said it was about 9pm when Donna returned to the hotel.
sentences.zh: 他说唐娜回到酒店时大约是晚上9点。

sentences.en: At this time, Keith decided it would be a good time to leave, and he went back to the bowling club to see Debbie.
sentences.zh: 此时，基思觉得离开是个好时机，于是他回到保龄球俱乐部去找黛比。

sentences.en: They left the bowling club together about 10pm and went straight back to Keith's home, where they went to bed together.
sentences.zh: 他们大约在晚上10点一起离开保龄球俱乐部，直接回到基思的家，在那里上床睡觉。

sentences.en: They arrived home at about 10.30pm.
sentences.zh: 他们大约在晚上10点30分到家。

sentences.en: A bit later on, Keith heard Colin walk inside, and sometime around midnight,
sentences.zh: 过了一会儿，基思听到科林走进屋里，大约在午夜左右，

sentences.en: Keith was woken up by the washing machine.
sentences.zh: 基思被洗衣机的声音吵醒了。

sentences.en: Colin decided it was a good idea to do some washing.
sentences.zh: 科林觉得这时候洗衣服是个好主意。

sentences.en: Keith wasn't too impressed with this, and he got up and had it out with Colin.
sentences.zh: 基思对此并不买账，他起身找科林理论。

sentences.en: Keith turned off the washing machine and went back to bed.
sentences.zh: 基思关掉洗衣机，又回到了床上。

sentences.en: Keith said he noticed that along with Colin's clothes, there was also a pair of shoes in the machine.
sentences.zh: 基思说他注意到，除了科林的衣服，洗衣机里还有一双鞋。

sentences.en: Keith's interview was somewhat similar to Colin's.
sentences.zh: 基思的讯问笔录与科林的有点相似。

sentences.en: Colin said in his interview, he was with Donna at the Regent's Park Hotel before leaving for a while to go to the bowling club.
sentences.zh: 科林在讯问中说，他在摄政公园酒店和唐娜在一起，后来离开了一会儿去了保龄球俱乐部。

sentences.en: That's when Donna got a call from her ex-husband, John.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，唐娜接到了前夫约翰的电话。

sentences.en: Colin went back to the Regent's Park Hotel, and Donna met him back there a bit later on.
sentences.zh: 科林回到了摄政公园酒店，过了一会儿唐娜也回那里去见了他。

sentences.en: So their stories seemed to match up, but there was one important discrepancy.
sentences.zh: 所以他们的说法似乎吻合，但有一个重要的矛盾之处。

sentences.en: Keith says he got home about 10.30pm, and Colin got home after him.
sentences.zh: 基思说他大约在10点30分到家，科林在他之后回家。

sentences.en: But Colin says he was home by 9.00, 9.30pm.
sentences.zh: 但科林说他9点或9点30分就到家了。

sentences.en: That was an important difference, although it was only an hour.
sentences.zh: 这是一个重要的差异，尽管只差了一个小时。

sentences.en: So is it possible that one of the brothers was simply mistaken with their time?
sentences.zh: 那么，有没有可能是这两个兄弟中有人记错了时间呢？

sentences.en: And of course there was the other question, what was Colin doing his washing after midnight for?
sentences.zh: 当然还有另一个问题，科林为什么要在半夜洗衣服？

sentences.en: Was this normal?
sentences.zh: 这正常吗？

sentences.en: Debbie corroborated Keith's version, although she wasn't exactly independent.
sentences.zh: 黛比证实了基思的说法，尽管她并不是完全独立无关的证人。

sentences.en: It wasn't any great shock that she backed up Keith's story.
sentences.zh: 她支持基思的说法并不令人感到太震惊。

sentences.en: So now who is the number one suspect?
sentences.zh: 那么现在谁是头号嫌疑人？

sentences.en: We've got Colin washing his clothes after midnight.
sentences.zh: 我们发现科林在半夜洗衣服。

sentences.en: We've got Keith with Donna's wallet under his bed.
sentences.zh: 我们发现基思的床底下藏着唐娜的钱包。

sentences.en: We've got a blood smear in their lounge room.
sentences.zh: 我们在他们的起居室里发现了血迹。

sentences.en: And one of them was possibly lying about their movements on the night Donna was murdered, and lying about what time they got home.
sentences.zh: 而且他们中有人可能在唐娜遇害当晚的行踪上说了谎，并且在回家时间上说了谎。

sentences.en: And what about this mystery caller?
sentences.zh: 那这个神秘的来电者又是怎么回事？

sentences.en: Who did she go and meet?
sentences.zh: 她去见了谁？

sentences.en: No matter who detectives thought was responsible, there was a difference between believing someone had committed a murder, and being able to prove it beyond a reasonable doubt.
sentences.zh: 不管侦探们认为谁应当负责，相信某人犯下了谋杀罪与能够排除合理怀疑地证明这一点之间是有区别的。

sentences.en: Police had no witnesses, and they still didn't have the DNA results back.
sentences.zh: 警方没有目击证人，而且DNA检测结果还没出来。

sentences.en: They didn't have enough to make a case against anybody just yet.
sentences.zh: 他们目前还没有足够的证据对任何人提起诉讼。

sentences.en: The post-mortem was conducted on Donna on Thursday the 5th of November 1999.
sentences.zh: 对唐娜的尸检于1999年11月5日星期四进行。

sentences.en: Her facial injuries were extensive, and it was determined that they were suffered by the use of extreme force.
sentences.zh: 她面部的伤势很重，经判定是遭受了极大的外力所致。

sentences.en: Death was determined to be due to a combination of severe head trauma and multiple stab wounds.
sentences.zh: 经判定，死因是严重头部创伤和多处刺伤共同导致的。

sentences.en: Despite the fact she was naked from the waist down, there was no evidence of sexual assault.
sentences.zh: 尽管她腰部以下赤裸，但没有性侵的证据。

sentences.en: As the investigation continued, police find that the two phone calls Donna received the night of her death at 8.30pm and 8.39pm were both from John, her ex-husband.
sentences.zh: 随着调查的继续，警方发现唐娜在遇害当晚8点30分和8点39分接到的两个电话都来自她的前夫约翰。

sentences.en: They were the only calls she had answered that night.
sentences.zh: 那是她当晚唯一接听过的电话。

sentences.en: There was no other mysterious caller, no mysterious person she met at Ashfield.
sentences.zh: 没有其他神秘来电者，也没有她在阿什菲尔德见到的神秘人。

sentences.en: John was the only person Donna went out to meet that night.
sentences.zh: 约翰是唐娜那天晚上唯一外出见面的人。

sentences.en: That was significant, as were the DNA results that had come back.
sentences.zh: 这意义重大，返回的DNA检测结果也是如此。

sentences.en: The plastic bag located in Donna's lounge room contained a bloody fingerprint.
sentences.zh: 在唐娜起居室里找到的塑料袋上有一个带血的指纹。

sentences.en: The blood was Donna's, the fingerprint wasn't.
sentences.zh: 血是唐娜的，指纹不是。

sentences.en: And the towel located in the lounge room contained two blood samples.
sentences.zh: 起居室里的毛巾上有两个血样。

sentences.en: One sample was Donna's.
sentences.zh: 一个样本是唐娜的。

sentences.en: The other blood sample belonged to the same person who owned the fingerprint.
sentences.zh: 另一个血样属于留下指纹的那个人。

sentences.en: Detectives decided it was time to get one of the Bond brothers back into the station for another interview.
sentences.zh: 侦探们决定是时候把邦德兄弟中的一个带回局里进行另一次讯问了。

sentences.en: On the 15th of November 1999,
Colin Bond was arrested, and he was interviewed for a second time.
sentences.zh: 科林·邦德被捕，并接受了第二次讯问。

sentences.en: It was here he learnt that there was a bloody fingerprint at the scene matched to him, and his blood was also found at the scene.
sentences.zh: 正是在这里，他得知现场有一个与他匹配的血指纹，而且他的血也在现场被发现。

sentences.en: There was more bad news.
sentences.zh: 还有更多坏消息。

sentences.en: The blood on his watch that police had seized at the search warrant,
sentences.zh: 警察在搜查令中没收的他的手表上的血迹，

sentences.en: that was Donna's blood.
sentences.zh: 那是唐娜的血。

sentences.en: But that wasn't enough to convince Colin.
sentences.zh: 但这还不足以让科林信服。

sentences.en: He stuck to his story.
sentences.zh: 他坚持自己的说法。

sentences.en: He was adamant that they were at Donna's house eating Chinese, and she got a phone call.
sentences.zh: 他坚称他们当时在唐娜家吃中餐，她接到了一个电话。

sentences.en: When she got that phone call, she said she had to leave to meet somebody in Ashfield, and she dropped him home.
sentences.zh: 当她接到那个电话时，她说她必须离开去阿什菲尔德见某个人，并顺路送他回家。

sentences.en: He again maintained that he got home about 9 or 9.30pm.
sentences.zh: 他再次坚称自己大约在9点或9点半到家。

sentences.en: But there was a problem with this story.
sentences.zh: 但这个说法有个问题。

sentences.en: Police had a lot more information by now.
sentences.zh: 警方现在掌握了更多信息。

sentences.en: They were actually able to confirm Keith's story that he got home around 10.30pm, and Colin wasn't there.
sentences.zh: 他们实际上能够证实基思的说法，即他大约在10点30分到家，而科林当时不在那儿。

sentences.en: They were able to confirm that Donna didn't answer any phone calls after the 8.39pm call from John.
sentences.zh: 他们能够证实，在约翰8点39分的电话之后，唐娜没有接听任何电话。

sentences.en: They were able to confirm she had her meeting with John, and then returned to Regent's Park Hotel after that.
sentences.zh: 他们能够证实她和约翰见了面，之后回到了摄政公园酒店。

sentences.en: The Chinese meal was bought after Donna's last phone call.
sentences.zh: 中餐是在唐娜最后一次通话后买的。

sentences.en: Nobody called Donna while Colin was at her house.
sentences.zh: 科林在唐娜家的时候没有人给她打电话。

sentences.en: Donna didn't leave to go and meet anybody, and she definitely didn't drop Colin home about 9.00, 9.30pm.
sentences.zh: 唐娜没有离开去见任何人，也绝对没有在9点或9点半左右顺路送科林回家。

sentences.en: There was no sign of forced entry to the house.
sentences.zh: 房子没有遭到强行闯入的迹象。

sentences.en: Colin had an injury consistent with punching someone with extreme force.
sentences.zh: 科林身上的伤与用极大力度击打某人相符。

sentences.en: They could prove he was lying.
sentences.zh: 他们能证明他在撒谎。

sentences.en: It finally became too much for Colin when detectives asked him if he could again clarify his movements between 9.30pm and 10.30pm.
sentences.zh: 当侦探们要求他再次澄清晚上9点30分到10点30分之间的行踪时，科林终于彻底崩溃了。

sentences.en: He replied,
sentences.zh: 他回答道，

sentences.en: Colin Bond was charged with the murder of Donna Wheeler.
sentences.zh: 科林·邦德被控谋杀唐娜·惠勒。

sentences.en: He had tried to cover his tracks once he got home.
sentences.zh: 他到家后曾试图掩盖行踪。

sentences.en: He washed his clothes and his shoes.
sentences.zh: 他洗了衣服和鞋子。

sentences.en: He had a shower.
sentences.zh: 他冲了个澡。

sentences.en: But what happened was he took his watch off to have the shower, not realising there was a blood speck on the watch.
sentences.zh: 但实际情况是，他为了洗澡摘下了手表，却没意识到表上有一个血点。

sentences.en: But at the end of the day, the watch was just another string to the bow.
sentences.zh: 不过说到底，这块手表只是又一条佐证。

sentences.en: The bloody fingerprint and his blood at the scene were more than enough to charge him.
sentences.zh: 现场的血手印和他的血迹足以对他提出指控。

sentences.en: Colin Bond stood trial in June 2001.
sentences.zh: 科林·邦德于2001年6月接受审判。

sentences.en: Colin's defence team had a little glimmer of hope to work with.
sentences.zh: 科林的辩护团队抓住了一线希望。

sentences.en: Keith was subpoenaed to attend court and give evidence, but he refused.
sentences.zh: 基思被传唤出庭作证，但他拒绝了。

sentences.en: He didn't comply with the subpoena, and he went into hiding.
sentences.zh: 他没有遵从传唤，而是躲了起来。

sentences.en: This gave the defence team their opportunity.
sentences.zh: 这为辩护团队提供了机会。

sentences.en: They worked hard the entire trial to say that Keith was a killer.
sentences.zh: 他们在整个审判过程中竭力宣称基思才是凶手。

sentences.en: After all, he was the one with a history of violence against Donna.
sentences.zh: 毕竟，他是那个对唐娜有暴力史的人。

sentences.en: They tried to put that doubt in the jury's mind.
sentences.zh: 他们试图在陪审团心中种下这种怀疑。

sentences.en: They only needed to convince one that Keith was on the run because he was guilty.
sentences.zh: 他们只需要说服其中一人，让大家觉得基思是因为心虚才潜逃。

sentences.en: On the 29th of June, the jury retired to reach a verdict.
sentences.zh: 6月29日，陪审团退庭商议裁决结果。

sentences.en: It didn't take them all.
sentences.zh: 他们并没有花太长时间。

sentences.en: They were back very quickly.
sentences.zh: 他们很快就回来了。

sentences.en: Colin Bond was found guilty of murder and sentenced to 30 years in jail with a non-parole period of 25 years.
sentences.zh: 科林·邦德谋杀罪名成立，被判处30年监禁，其中25年不得假释。

sentences.en: When the finding was read out,
sentences.zh: 当宣读判决结果时，

sentences.en: Donna's mother yelled at Colin to rot in hell.
sentences.zh: 唐娜的母亲大声咒骂科林下地狱。

sentences.en: He just glared at her with a smug, arrogant look.
sentences.zh: 他只是带着自鸣得意、傲慢的神情怒视着她。

sentences.en: He was sent to Lithgow Jail to serve out his sentence.
sentences.zh: 他被送往利思戈监狱服刑。

sentences.en: There's no doubt Colin killed Donna.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问，科林杀害了唐娜。

sentences.en: But in case for some reason one of the jurors had some lingering doubt, or in case anyone listening has a doubt, the Crown Prosecutor took the unusual step
sentences.zh: 但以防万一某个陪审员心中仍存疑虑，或者收听节目的任何人有疑问，皇家检察官采取了一个不寻常的举动，

sentences.en: of requesting that the jury stay in the courtroom while Colin's criminal record was read.
sentences.zh: 要求在宣读科林的犯罪记录时，陪审团继续留在法庭内。

sentences.en: They got to hear about a murder Colin had previously committed that bore a chilling resemblance to the murder of Donna Wheeler.
sentences.zh: 他们得知了科林以前曾犯下的一起谋杀案，该案与谋杀唐娜·惠勒的案件惊人地相似。

sentences.en: In 1987, Colin Bond attacked a woman.
sentences.zh: 1987年，科林·邦德袭击了一名女性。

sentences.en: According to Colin, it went like this.
sentences.zh: 据科林所说，事情是这样的。

sentences.en: With a few beers under my belt, I got the shits and hit her.
sentences.zh: 喝了几杯啤酒后，我火冒三丈，打了她。

sentences.en: That was a gross under-exaggeration.
sentences.zh: 这完全是轻描淡写。

sentences.en: The woman's face was beaten to a bloody pulp.
sentences.zh: 那名女性的脸被打得血肉模糊。

sentences.en: He left her for dead, taking off her pants, leaving her naked from the waist down.
sentences.zh: 他将她抛弃等死，脱掉了她的裤子，让她腰部以下赤身裸体。

sentences.en: She died 16 days later as a result of those sickening facial injuries.
sentences.zh: 16天后，她因这些令人发指的面部伤势而死亡。

sentences.en: Police at the time were of the opinion that the woman had rejected Colin's sexual advances, so he snapped and bludgeoned her to death.
sentences.zh: 当时的警方认为，该女性拒绝了科林的求爱，于是他情绪失控，将她殴打致死。

sentences.en: Police were of the opinion and that's exactly what happened with Donna.
sentences.zh: 警方认为是这样，而这正是发生在唐娜身上的事情。

sentences.en: Colin made sexual advances towards her that she rejected.
sentences.zh: 科林对她展开追求遭到了拒绝。

sentences.en: Somehow, Colin was able to plead that first murder charge down to manslaughter and was sentenced to 20 years jail with a non-parole period of 10 years.
sentences.zh: 不知怎的，科林竟然把第一起谋杀指控辩诉为过失杀人，被判处20年监禁，其中10年不得假释。

sentences.en: Of course, he only served a minimum 10 years and was out of jail less than 12 months before he killed Donna Wheeler.
sentences.zh: 当然，他只服刑了最低10年，出狱不到12个月就杀害了唐娜·惠勒。

sentences.en: Imagine if the courts had have imposed a proper sentence.
sentences.zh: 试想一下，如果法院当时判处了合适的刑罚，

sentences.en: Donna Wheeler might still be alive today.
sentences.zh: 唐娜·惠勒今天也许还活着。

sentences.en: And of course, this information couldn't be brought up during Colin's trial as it would have been unfair to him if the jury had knowledge of that previous charge.
sentences.zh: 当然，这些信息在科林的审判期间是不能提出的，因为如果陪审团知道他以前的指控，对他来说就不公平了。

sentences.en: Donna and her mother were both aware that Colin had been in jail for killing a woman.
sentences.zh: 唐娜和她的母亲都知道科林曾因杀害一名女性而入狱。

sentences.en: Donna's mum told her to be very careful hanging around him.
sentences.zh: 唐娜的妈妈告诫她要当心和他来往。

sentences.en: But Donna believed the story that Colin had told her about it.
sentences.zh: 但唐娜相信了科林向她讲述的那个版本。

sentences.en: His explanation to Donna was that he became involved in a heated argument with the girl and he pushed her over.
sentences.zh: 他对唐娜的解释是，他和那个女孩发生了激烈的争吵，他把她推倒了。

sentences.en: When she fell, she hit her head and died.
sentences.zh: 她摔倒时头部撞击地面身亡。

sentences.en: It was all an accident, according to him.
sentences.zh: 据他说，这一切都是意外。

sentences.en: I guess the light sentence
sentences.zh: 我猜判决的轻描淡写

sentences.en: Colin got fell in line with that story so I can see why Donna might have believed it.
sentences.zh: 与科林的说法不谋而合，所以我能理解为什么唐娜会相信。

sentences.en: If only she knew the truth.
sentences.zh: 要是她知道真相就好了。

sentences.en: Colin ended up dying of a heart attack a few years into his 30-year sentence.
sentences.zh: 科林在30年刑期过去几年后，因心脏病发作客死狱中。

sentences.en: But just think, he had already committed two sickening murders but he still would have been eligible for parole in his late 70s.
sentences.zh: 但想想看，他已经犯下了两起令人发指的谋杀案，却依然能在七十多岁时获得假释资格。

sentences.en: I'll see you next time.
sentences.zh: 我们下期再见。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。
